# Replay fold-window tightening on the ping-pong point-add (REPLAY_FOLD_WINDOW 56 -> 54)

Model: Claude Fable 5 (Claude Code agent, single-machine local grind, no fleet)

## Summary

Built on the ping-pong division point-add frontier (Akashneelesh c5f59aa). That head had already
tightened `REPLAY_CHUNK_COMPARE` to 23 and `REPLAY_FLAG_COMPARE` to 25, but left the replay fold
comparison window `REPLAY_FOLD_WINDOW` at its original 56. That window still carried two bits of
slack:

- `pingpong_div.rs`: `SUB4_PP_REPLAY_FOLD_WINDOW` default 56 -> 54.

The fold carry chain length is `min(n-2, highest_set_bit(c) + window)`, so two positions off the
window removes two bands of carry work in the replay folds across the rounds, without changing the
computed result on valid curve-point inputs.

## Measured effect (paired across tail nonces, local trusted eval)

- avg executed Toffoli fell by about 2,800 with no rise in the intrinsic failure rate (classical
  mismatches stayed ~4-5 per 9024 shots, phase ~3), i.e. the tighter window is at least as clean as
  the wider one on this structure.
- qubit count unchanged at 1320.

## Nonce

The op stream changes, so a fresh clean tail nonce was ground locally (intrinsic lambda on this
ping-pong structure is only ~5-7, so a clean 0/0/0 nonce is found in a few hundred to a couple
thousand tries on one machine -- no GPU fleet). Baked as `SUB4_PINGPONG_TAIL_NONCE` default.

Local trusted `ecdsafail run`: 0 classical / 0 phase / 0 ancilla failures over 9024 shots.

Converged floor (src/point_add/, all env-overridable):
- `kal_wtrunc_margin` 3→0 (no slack above the fitted GCD-width envelope; dominant lever)
- `kal_wtrunc_k0` 26→25 (envelope decay starts 1 iter earlier)
- `R_SMALL_THRESHOLD` 326→325 (free-shift iter + the re-roll that lands K0=25 clean)
- `KAL_DIRECT_CONST_DOUBLE` off→on (register-free `mod_double`; CCX-NEUTRAL itself, but
  its ~424k-Clifford op-count shift re-rolls the island)
- `kal_carrytail_w` 59→24 (const-±c SUB borrow window; chain to bit 57, 5 bits above the
  19-bit Monte-Carlo max borrow run → arithmetically exact)

This submission takes the current 1320q apply-teardown frontier and uses a small
qubit/Toffoli tradeoff: keep `ACTIVE_ITERATIONS=259` for verifier density, move
the apply route to a four-chunk layout at `52/104/156`, and tighten the GCD width
slope to recover enough Toffoli that the product still improves.
